headline.en: Cadastral Surveys in Kenya for Title Deeds, Subdivision & Boundary Verification
headline.sw: Uchunguzi wa Cadastral nchini Kenya kwa Hati Miliki, Ugawaji wa Viwanja na Uthibitisho wa Mipaka

description.en: Registry-accurate boundary surveys prepared by licensed surveyors and packaged for Ardhisasa submission — for buyers, landowners and developers.
description.sw: Uchunguzi sahihi wa mipaka kwa viwango vya usajili, ulioandaliwa na wachunguzi walioidhinishwa na kutayarishwa kwa uwasilishaji wa Ardhisasa — kwa wanunuzi, wamiliki wa ardhi na wasanidi miradi.

headline.en: When You Need a Cadastral Survey

description.en: From title verification to dispute resolution — these are the moments a licensed boundary survey protects your land, your money and your paperwork.
description.sw: Kuanzia uthibitisho wa hati hadi suluhisho la migogoro — hivi ni muda ambao uchunguzi wa mipaka ulioidhinishwa unalinda ardhi yako, pesa yako na nyaraka zako.

imageBadge.sw: Sheria ya Upimaji Sura ya 299 · Tayari kwa Ardhisasa

title.en: Buying Land / Verifying a Title Deed

description.en: Confirm the parcel on the ground matches the deed plan and registry records — before you pay a single shilling.
description.sw: Thibitisha kuwa kiwanja kilichopo ardhini kinaendana na ramani ya hati na rekodi za usajili — kabla ya kulipa shilingi hata moja.

description.en: Legally split a parcel into saleable units with approved subdivision plans, mutation survey and new beacons.
description.sw: Gawa kiwanja kisheria kuwa vitengo vinavyouzwa kwa ramani za ugawaji zilizoidhinishwa, uchunguzi wa mutation na beacon mpya.

title.sw: Kutatua Migogoro ya Kisheria ya Mipaka

description.en: Court-ready boundary evidence and re-established beacons to settle ownership lines with adjoining owners.
description.sw: Ushahidi wa mipaka unaofaa mahakamani na beacon zilizohuishwa upya kutatua mistari ya umiliki na wamiliki jirani.

description.en: Certified boundary data that counties, banks and authorities expect before approving building plans.
description.sw: Takwimu za mipaka zilizothibitishwa ambazo kaunti, benki na mamlaka huhitaji kabla ya kuidhinisha ramani za ujenzi.

description.en: Unit boundary determination and sectional plans for apartment and mixed-use registrations.
description.sw: Uamuzi wa mipaka ya vitengo na ramani za sectional kwa usajili wa ghorofa na maeneo ya matumizi mchanganyiko.

description.en: Know exactly what you own before buying, selling, mortgaging or developing land.
description.sw: Jua hasa unachomiliki kabla ya kununua, kuuza, kuweka rehani au kuendeleza ardhi.

description.en: Detect overlapping fences, structures and access rights early — and correct them before they escalate into legal battles or stalled transactions.
description.sw: Gundua ua, miundo na haki za njia zinazopishana mapema — na uzirekebishe kabla ya kuwa migogoro ya kisheria au miamala iliyosimama.

headline.en: Boundary Survey Process — From Site Visit to County Approval
headline.sw: Mchakato wa Uchunguzi wa Mipaka — Kutoka Ziara ya Tovuti hadi Idhini ya Kaunti

description.en: A transparent, six-step cadastral workflow. You always know which stage your parcel is in and exactly what happens next.
description.sw: Mtiririko wa kazi wa hati sita ulio wazi. Unajua wakati wowote kiwanja chako kiko katika hatua gani na kinachofuata hasa.

label.sw: Ziara ya Tovuti & Ukaguzi wa Nyaraka

description.en: We walk the parcel with you, review the title deed, deed plan and prior surveys, and record existing occupation and improvements.
description.sw: Tunatembea kiwanja pamoja nawe, tunakagua hati miliki, ramani ya hati na uchunguzi wa awali, na kurekodi makazi na maboresho yaliyopo.

description.en: Parcel records are retrieved and cross-checked against the Registry Index Map (RIM) and the Ardhisasa cadastral database to confirm the legal boundaries.
description.sw: Rekodi za kiwanja zinapatikana na kulinganishwa na Ramani ya Faharasa ya Usajili (RIM) na hifadhidata ya Ardhisasa ili kuthibitisha mipaka ya kisheria.

label.sw: Uchunguzi wa Shamba wa GNSS (RTK Control)

description.en: RTK GNSS and total station observations establish a control network tied to the national grid for centimetre-level accuracy.
description.sw: Uchunguzi wa RTK GNSS na total station unaanzisha mtandao wa udhibiti uliounganishwa na gridi ya kitaifa kwa usahihi wa kiwango cha sentimita.

description.en: Boundary corners are computed, confirmed with adjoining owners, and permanent beacons are placed or re-fixed on the ground.
description.sw: Kona za mipaka zinakokotolewa, zinathibitishwa na wamiliki jirani, na beacon za kudura zinawekwa au kurekebishwa ardhini.

description.en: Observations are reduced and adjusted; areas, traverses and final survey plans are computed and checked by a licensed surveyor.
description.sw: Uchunguzi unapunguzwa na kurekebishwa; eneo, traverses na ramani za mwisho zinakokotolewa na kukaguliwa na mchunguzi aliyeidhinishwa.

description.en: The compiled cadastral documentation is lodged with the registry (Ardhisasa) and county offices for approval and registration.
description.sw: Nyaraka za cadastral zilizokusanyika zinawasilishwa kwa usajili (Ardhisasa) na ofisi za kaunti kwa idhini na usajili.

headline.sw: Anza Mchakato Wako wa Uchunguzi Leo

description.en: Send us your parcel details — title deed number, location and size — and we will map out the exact survey steps, costs and approvals for your land.
description.sw: Tutumie maelezo ya kiwanja chako — namba ya hati, eneo na ukubwa — nasi tutakupangia hatua halisi za uchunguzi, gharama na idhini za ardhi yako.

headline.en: How Long Does a Cadastral Survey Take?
headline.sw: Uchunguzi wa Cadastral Huchukua Muda Gani?

description.en: Survey duration depends on registry approvals and parcel complexity. Here is what to realistically plan for.
description.sw: Muda wa uchunguzi unategemea idhini za usajili na ugumu wa kiwanja. Hii ni ya kweli ya kupanga nayo.

scaleNote.en: Bar length shows the typical maximum duration of each service.
scaleNote.sw: Urefu wa mstari unaonyesha muda wa juu wa kawaida wa kila huduma.

description.en: Boundary verification and beaconing, depending on registry approvals and access to the parcel.
description.sw: Uthibitisho wa mipaka na kuweka beacon, kulingana na idhini za usajili na ufikiaji wa kiwanja.

description.en: Planning consent, mutation survey, plan approval and registration of the new units.
description.sw: Idhini ya mipango, uchunguzi wa mutation, idhini ya ramani na usajili wa vitengo vipya.

description.en: Court or family-mediated disputes take longer — evidence quality determines how fast they settle.
description.sw: Migogoro ya mahakama au ya kifamilia hudumu muda mrefu — ubora wa ushahidi unaamua kasi ya kutatuliwa.

note.en: Delays almost always come from registry queues and missing documents — we pre-clear both before fieldwork starts.
note.sw: Chelezo karibu daima hutoka kwa foleni za usajili na nyaraka zilizokosekana — tunayatatua zote mbili kabla ya kazi ya shamba kuanza.

headline.en: Legal & Ardhisasa Compliance You Can Rely On
headline.sw: Uzingatiaji wa Kisheria & Ardhisasa Unaweza Kutegemea

description.en: Every cadastral survey we deliver is executed under the statutes that govern land in Kenya — so your documents survive scrutiny at the registry, the bank and the court.
description.sw: Kila uchunguzi wa cadastral tunaoleta hutekelezwa chini ya sheria zinazosimamia ardhi nchini Kenya — hivyo nyaraka zako zinapita ukaguzi kwa usajili, benki na mahakama.

description.en: Surveys prepared for registration under the Act governing title deeds, parcel boundaries and transfers in Kenya.
description.sw: Uchunguzi ulioandaliwa kwa usajili chini ya Sheria inayosimamia hati miliki, mipaka ya vipande na uhamisho nchini Kenya.

description.en: All fieldwork, computations and plans conform to the Survey Act and its Regulations — signed by a licensed surveyor.
description.sw: Kazi zote za shamba, kokotoo na ramani zinazingatia Sheria ya Upimaji na Kanuni zake — zikisainiwa na mchunguzi aliyeidhinishwa.

description.en: Deliverables are packaged to Ardhisasa digital lodgement standards: georeferenced data, deed plans and supporting documents.
description.sw: Matokeo yamepakitiwa kwa viwango vya uwasilishaji wa kidijitali vya Ardhisasa: takwimu zilizogeoreferensiwa, ramani za hati na nyaraka za ziada.

description.en: We liaise with county planning offices for subdivision consents and development approvals tied to your survey.
description.sw: Tunashirikiana na ofisi za mipango za kaunti kwa idhini za ugawaji na uidhinishaji wa maendeleo yanayohusiana na uchunguzi wako.

description.en: Work is executed and signed off by an Institution of Surveyors of Kenya (ISK) registered, licensed surveyor.
description.sw: Kazi hutekelezwa na kusainiwa na mchunguzi aliyeandikishwa na aliyeidhinishwa wa Taasisi ya Wapimaji Ardhi Kenya (ISK).

text.en: This project demonstrates how modern GNSS-based cadastral surveying eliminates ambiguity in land ownership boundaries while ensuring compliance with Kenyan land registration frameworks. SmartGrid Surveying integrates field precision + legal geospatial intelligence to convert disputed land into registrable, investment-ready assets.
text.sw: Mradi huu unaonyesha jinsi uchunguzi wa kisasa wa cadastral unaotumia GNSS unavyoondoa utata katika mipaka ya umiliki wa ardhi huku ukidumisha uzingatiaji wa mifumo ya usajili wa ardhi ya Kenya. SmartGrid Surveying inaunganisha usahihi wa shamba + akili ya kijiografia ya kisheria kubadilisha ardhi inayogombaniwa kuwa mali zinazosajiliwa na tayari kwa uwekezaji.
